newsitem.title: USA: Young to buy back stake from Cap Cities.
newsitem.headline: Young to buy back stake from Cap Cities.

text.p: Young Broadcasting Inc said on Monday it had signed an agreement to buy back Capital Cities/ABC Inc's equity interest in Young.
Young signed the deal with Walt Disney Co, the corporate parent of Cap Cities.
Cap Cities's equity interest in Young consists of 1.5 million shares of Young Class C common stock and a warrant to purchase an additional 750,000 Class C shares, Young said.

Young also said it was amending a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission to decrease the number of Class A common shares to be sold in its proposed public offering, to six million from 6,626,263.
The offering will consist of 5,250,000 primary shares and 750,000 secondary shares, it said.
Merrill Lynch, Alex. Brown, Bankers Trust, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan are underwriters for the offering. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
